The '''Daupherm system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Daupherm Planet States]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Daupherm/Legends|Daupherm]].
